3233.title: Concurrent workspace finalization exposes database constraint text
3233.rootCauseOneLine: Concurrent pathless unmanaged environments can finalize to one path, and the losing uniqueness error is persisted verbatim.
3233.proposedFix: Translate the named environment path uniqueness conflict at provisioning settlement into a stable server-domain conflict message.
3233.caveats: The exact host-disconnect choreography was not repeated; the underlying concurrent settlement was reproduced twice.
